title: Point AGENTS.md at the short onboarding path
lead: AGENTS.md stops telling every session to read README, ARCHITECTURE.md, and docs/agents.md. The invariants already listed in AGENTS.md are the session reading. ARCHITECTURE.md is opened only when a change touches one of them. docs/agents.md is opened only for the one command whose JSON contract is being changed.
findings_note: session 2026-10-08; AGENTS.md sends every slice through README, the 16 KB ARCHITECTURE.md, and the 56 KB docs/agents.md
boundary: **Not in this slice:** editing README, ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/agents.md, or the installed skill; deleting any of those files; reviving `slicer ai reference` (s180 was retired because a second copy of the contract table costs more than it saves).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The skill is 4.6 KB and `slicer ai instructions --rest` is 5 KB. AGENTS.md still opens with an instruction to read ARCHITECTURE.md before any non-trivial change, and the roadmap section says to read README.md and ARCHITECTURE.md first and points at docs/agents.md for the contracts. docs/agents.md is 56,588 bytes. That is the remaining token cost on every slice. The credit-saving commands (lean JSON, `--section`, note budgets, `--rest`) are already shipped.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `AGENTS.md`: the opening paragraph, and the one sentence in "Working on the roadmap" that names README, ARCHITECTURE.md, and docs/agents.md
- `tests/test_ai.py`
- `CHANGELOG.md`

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Replace the opening paragraph with:

```
Project guidance for slicer. The invariants are the list under "What a change must not break". Open ARCHITECTURE.md only when a change touches one of them.
```

Replace this sentence in "Working on the roadmap":

```
Read README.md and ARCHITECTURE.md first. Use `slicer ai instructions` for onboarding; [docs/agents.md](docs/agents.md) has the command/JSON contracts.
```

with:

```
Use `slicer ai instructions` for onboarding. The invariants named in this file are the session reading. Open ARCHITECTURE.md only when a change touches one of them, and open docs/agents.md only for the one command whose JSON contract you are changing.
```

That replacement is 100 bytes longer than the sentence it removes. The roadmap section is 3317 bytes today. After the replacement it is 3417. `test_AgentsGuide_LandingSection_PointsAtLandingDoc` requires that section to stay at or under 3500 bytes, and `test_AgentsGuide_RoadmapSection_IsShorter` requires it to stay under 3800. Do not add any other bytes to that section.

The new test reads AGENTS.md and asserts all of the following. The opening does not tell the reader to read ARCHITECTURE.md before a non-trivial change. The roadmap section does not contain `Read README.md`. The roadmap section does contain `one command` and `docs/agents.md`. The two existing size tests still pass. The pickup command, the landing stub, and `docs/landing.md` stay as they are.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: `python3 -m unittest tests.test_ai.AiGuideTests` passes. Then `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests`. `slicer check` passes. `git diff --check` is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Implement on a new worktree branched from main, one slice per worktree. This repo finishes with `handoff`. Do not commit, merge, or push until the owner asks. The other filed slice owns the Commands section of AGENTS.md; leave that section alone.
